kinds.LARGE_OUTFLOW: warn, a single outgoing payment of at least LARGE_OUTFLOW_RATIO (default 0.5) of the balance before it
kinds.MISSED_PAYMENT: critical, a Moonshift loan passed its due time with no MS_REPAY from the borrower
kinds.MS_REPAY: info, borrower repaid a Moonshift loan
kinds.MS_LOAN_DISBURSE: info, borrower received a Moonshift loan
kinds.MARGIN_CALL: warn, borrower received a payment with memo MS_MARGIN_CALL
kinds.LIQUIDATION: critical, the lender finished (claimed) a collateral escrow owned by the borrower
